object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In DOC, edit one object, add one and delete one. Make the discard fail after its first file is written, for example by making a later file read-only or holding it open on Windows. Remove the cause and discard again. Expected: the second discard leaves DOC exactly as the latest commit holds it, with no uncommitted change. No test makes a discard fail partway.
